hints.en: An hour of tape is a lot to watch blind. Does anyone know roughly when she came through?
hints.hr: Sat vremena snimke je puno za gledati naslijepo. Zna li itko otprilike kad je prošla?

hints.en: Baka Kata saw her cross Jelačić 'around half past nine,' walking fast toward the station — a ten-to-fifteen-minute walk. Start scrubbing there.
hints.hr: Baka Kata ju je vidjela kako prelazi Jelačić 'oko pola deset,' brzim korakom prema kolodvoru — deset do petnaest minuta hoda. Počni premotavati odande.

hints.en: Backpack, crying, moving fast — she won't blend in. Watch close around 09:45.
hints.hr: Ruksak, plač, brz korak — neće se stopiti s okolinom. Pazi dobro oko 09:45.
